svg.title: A Pod arrives before its Job watch exists

g.text: A Pod arrives before its Job watch exists
team-a: Pod train-workers-1-0 -> Job train-workers-1 -> JobSet train
The JobSet watch is ready. The Job watch has not started.
A. Record the Pod and its owner
The Job has not arrived yet.
Watch setup and Pod reconciliation are queued separately.
If Resolve runs before the Job watch is ready, it returns
CoverageError(Job, ErrPending). The controller retries later.
Wait for the initial objects and their add handlers.
Status and component mapping are evaluated afterward.
